news.title: House committee moves to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve

news.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
news.summary: The legislation would effectively codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.
